src_en: Take 2 tablets with a full glass of water.
translation: 服用 2 个平板片和一个满杯水.
back_translation: Take two tablets and a full glass of water.

src_en: Take one tablet every 8 hours.
translation: 每8小时服用一次药丸.
back_translation: Take one pill every eight hours.

src_en: Do not take more than 6 tablets in 24 hours.
translation: 在24小时内不要服用超过6个药丸.
back_translation: Do not take more than 6 pills within 24 hours.

src_en: Do not crush or chew the tablets.
translation: 不要粉碎或食药.
back_translation: Don't crush or eat medicine.

src_en: Take this medicine with food.
translation: 与食物一起服用这种药物.
back_translation: This medicine is taken with food.

src_en: Use for 7 days, even if you feel better.
translation: 使用7天,即使您感觉更好.
back_translation: Use seven days, even if you feel better.

src_en: Measure 5 mL with the dosing cup provided.
translation: 与提供剂量杯一起测量5 ml.
back_translation: 5 ml is measured with a dose cup.

src_en: Children under 12 years should not take this medicine without asking a doctor.
translation: 12岁以下的儿童不应在没有咨询医生的情况下服用这种药物.
back_translation: Children under 12 years of age should not take this medicine without medical advice.

src_en: Call your doctor if your fever lasts more than 3 days.
translation: 如果您的发烧持续超过3天,请联系您的医生.
back_translation: If your fever lasts for more than 3 days, contact your doctor.

src_en: Store below 25 °C and keep out of the reach of children.
translation: 保存在25°C以下,保持在儿童无法接触的地方.
back_translation: Keep it below 25°C and keep it out of the reach of children.

src_en: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
translation: 如果您错过了剂量,请尽快记住.
back_translation: If you missed a dose, please remember as soon as possible.

src_en: Do not take two doses at the same time.
translation: 不要同时服用两个剂量.
back_translation: Do not take two doses at the same time.

src_en: Apply a thin layer to the affected skin twice a day.
translation: 每天两次将薄层涂在受影响的皮肤上.
back_translation: Apply a thin layer twice a day to the affected skin.

src_en: For use in the ear only.
translation: 仅适用于耳朵.
back_translation: It's only for the ears.

src_en: Take half a tablet in the morning.
translation: 早上服用一半药丸.
back_translation: Take half the pills in the morning.

src_en: Take 1 tablet at 8 a.m. and 1 tablet at 8 p.m.
translation: 每天早上8点服用1粒,晚上8点服用1粒.
back_translation: One dose is taken every day at 8:00 am and one dose at 8:00 pm.

src_en: Take 1 to 2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours as needed.
translation: 根据需要,每4到6小时服用1至2粒.
back_translation: If necessary, take 1 to 2 doses every 4 to 6 hours.

src_en: Do not exceed 4 doses in a 24-hour period.
translation: 在24小时内不要超过4剂量.
back_translation: Do not take more than 4 doses within 24 hours.

src_en: Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine.
translation: 在服用此药时,不要喝酒.
back_translation: Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.

src_en: Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
translation: 如果您怀孕或哺乳期,不要使用.
back_translation: Do not use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

src_en: Do not take with other medicines that contain the same active ingredient.
translation: 不要与含有相同活性成分的其他药物服用.
back_translation: Do not take other medicines with the same active ingredient.

src_en: Do not use for more than 3 days without medical advice.
translation: 在没有医生建议的情况下,不要使用超过3天.
back_translation: Do not use for more than 3 days without a doctor's advice.

src_en: Take 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 mL) twice daily.
translation: 每天两次服用1/ 2茶匙 (2,5毫升).
back_translation: Take 1/2 teaspoon (2.5 ml) twice a day.

src_en: Apply the 0.5% cream to clean, dry skin.
translation: 将0.5%的奶油涂在干净的皮肤上.
back_translation: Apply 0.5 per cent cream to clean skin.

src_en: Dissolve 1 packet in a glass of water and drink right away.
translation: 在一杯水中溶解一包,立即喝.
back_translation: Then dissolve it in a cup of water and drink it.

src_en: The dose is 10 mL for children weighing 20 to 30 kg.
translation: 对体重20-30公斤的儿童来说,剂量为10毫升.
back_translation: For children weighing 20-30 kg, the dose is 10 ml.

src_en: Each tablet contains 20 mg of Zolvera.
translation: 每个平板片都含有20 mg的Zolvera.
back_translation: Each tablet contained 20 mg of Zolvera.

src_en: Take once daily at bedtime.
translation: 在睡前每天服用一次.
back_translation: Take it once a day before bedtime.

src_en: Shake the bottle well before each use.
translation: 在每次使用之前,好好地摇动瓶子.
back_translation: Shake the bottle well before each use.

src_en: Put 2 drops in each eye 3 times a day.
translation: 每天三次将两滴滴滴入每只眼睛.
back_translation: It is recommended to put two drops in each eye three times a day.

src_en: Wait at least 4 hours between doses.
translation: 在剂量之间至少等待4个小时.
back_translation: Wait at least 4 hours between doses.

src_en: Swallow the capsule whole with water.
translation: 用水吞下整个囊.
back_translation: I swallowed the whole bag with water.

src_en: Avoid direct sunlight while using this cream.
translation: 在使用这种奶油时,避免直接阳光照射.
back_translation: When using this cream, avoid direct sunlight.

src_en: This medicine may cause drowsiness. Do not drive or use machines.
translation: 这种药物可能会导致睡眠. 不要开车或使用机器.
back_translation: Do not drive or use machinery.

src_en: Keep in the refrigerator between 2 °C and 8 °C.
translation: 在冰箱中保存2°C至8°C之间.
back_translation: Keep between 2°C and 8°C in the refrigerator.

src_en: Do not use after the expiry date printed on the box.
translation: 在盒子上打印的过期日期后不要使用.
back_translation: Do not use after the expiry date printed on the box.

src_en: Stop taking this medicine and call your doctor if you develop a rash.
translation: 停止服用这种药物,如果出现疹,请联系您的医生.
back_translation: Stop taking this medicine and contact your doctor if you develop a rash.

src_en: Take for 10 days. Finish all the tablets.
translation: 服用10天,完成所有的药丸.
back_translation: Take all the pills in 10 days.

src_en: Not recommended for babies under 6 months.
translation: 对于6个月以下的婴儿来说不建议.
back_translation: It is not recommended for babies under 6 months of age.

src_en: Take 1 tablet every 12 hours for 5 days.
translation: 在5天内每12小时服用1 viên.
back_translation: Take one tablet every 12 hours for 5 days.

src_en: Take 3 tablets on the first day, then 1 tablet a day for 4 days.
translation: 在第一天服用3个药丸,然后每天服用1个药丸4天.
back_translation: Take three pills on the first day and then one pill every day for four days.

src_en: Rinse your mouth with water after using the inhaler.
translation: 在使用吸入器后,用水冲洗口腔.
back_translation: After using the inhaler, rinse the mouth with water.

src_en: Use 2 puffs when needed. Do not use more than 8 puffs in 24 hours.
translation: 在需要时,使用2次抽,在24小时内不要使用超过8次抽.
back_translation: If necessary, use 2 shots and no more than 8 shots within 24 hours.

src_en: Take 1 capsule 30 minutes before breakfast.
translation: 在早餐前30分钟服用1个囊.
back_translation: Take one bag 30 minutes before breakfast.

src_en: Take this medicine on an empty stomach, at least 1 hour before meals.
translation: 在餐前至少1小时,在空腹服用此药物.
back_translation: Take this medicine at least one hour before meals, while fasting.

src_en: Place the tablet under your tongue and let it dissolve.
translation: 把平板放在舌头下面,然后让它溶解.
back_translation: Put the plate under your tongue and let it dissolve.

src_en: Do not stop taking this medicine suddenly.
translation: 不要突然停止服用这种药物.
back_translation: Do not stop taking this medicine suddenly.

src_en: Your urine may look orange. This is harmless.
translation: 你的尿液可能看起来色,这无害.
back_translation: Your urine may look colored, which is harmless.

src_en: Use only the dosing cup, not a kitchen spoon.
translation: 只用剂杯,不要用厨房子.
back_translation: Just use a glass of soda, not the kitchen.

src_en: Take 2 tablets now, then 1 tablet after 12 hours.
translation: 现在服用2粒,12小时后服用1粒.
back_translation: Now I'm taking 2 pills, and 12 hours later I'm taking 1 pills.

src_en: If your symptoms get worse or do not improve in 5 days, see a doctor.
translation: 如果您的症状在5天内恶化或不改善,请咨询医生.
back_translation: If your symptoms worsen or do not improve within 5 days, consult your doctor.

src_en: Give 7.5 mL to a child aged 6 to 11 years.
translation: 给6至11岁的儿童提供7.5 ml.
back_translation: 7.5 ml is given to children aged 6 to 11.

src_en: Wash your hands before and after applying the ointment.
translation: 在涂抹油之前和之后洗手.
back_translation: Wash your hands before and after applying the oil.

src_en: Do not apply to broken skin or near the eyes.
translation: 不要用在破碎的皮肤或眼睛附近.
back_translation: Do not use near broken skin or eyes.

src_en: Take 1 tablet every morning. The tablet strength is 40 mg.
translation: 每天早上服用 1 个药丸.
back_translation: Take one pill every morning.

src_en: Allow 2 hours between this medicine and antacids.
translation: 在此药物和抗酸药物之间保持2个小时.
back_translation: It is recommended to stay between this medication and the antacid for 2 hours.

src_en: Tell your doctor about all other medicines you take.
translation: 告诉您的医生您服用的所有其他药物.
back_translation: Tell your doctor about all other medicines you are taking.

src_en: This medicine is for adults over 18 years only.
translation: 这种药物仅适用于18岁以上的成年人.
back_translation: The drug is only available to adults over the age of 18.

src_en: Take 2 sachets daily, mixed with 200 mL of water.
translation: 每天服用2袋,混合200毫升水.
back_translation: Take 2 bags a day and mix 200 ml of water.

src_en: Seek emergency help right away if you have trouble breathing or swelling of the face.
translation: 如果您呼吸困难或脸部胀,请立即寻求急救.
back_translation: If you have difficulty breathing or a swollen face, seek immediate help.
